item.title: CleanMax beats Q2 EBITDA estimates, reports strong H1 growth
item.description: CleanMax has surpassed analyst estimates for the third consecutive quarter, driven by portfolio expansion and strong business performance. The company reported a 58% rise in H1 EBITDA and a six-fold increase in profit after tax (PAT), highlighting its robust growth momentum and improving financial performance.

item.title: Sebi levies Rs 40 lakh penalty on four entities in Axis MF front-running case
item.description: Securities and Exchange Board of India has imposed a total penalty of Rs 40 lakh on four entities. This penalty includes fines on Woodstock Broking and Marfatia Stock Broking for front-running trades. The investigation spanned from April 1, 2021, to March 31, 2022, involving these entities. Evidence indicated that brokers facilitated these trades by providing necessary infrastructure and assistance.

item.title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reports sixth consecutive quarterly loss
item.description: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank experienced a loss of Rs 70 crore in the second quarter, marking six consecutive quarters of decline. The lender’s operating profit was Rs 85 crore, but provisions of Rs 166 crore led to the net loss. Its gross non-performing asset ratio improved slightly, standing at 5.96% at the end of September. The bank's gross loan portfolio saw a year-on-year growth of 7.5%, reaching Rs 20,062 crore.

item.title: Nexus Select Trust’s Q2 NOI rises 8% to Rs 504 cr, consumption up 13%
item.description: Nexus Select Trust reported an 8% year-on-year increase in net operating income for the second quarter. The company's retail assets experienced a 13% rise in consumption compared to the previous year. Nexus declared a distribution of Rs 359 crore, maintaining a 100% payout to unitholders for 13 consecutive quarters. The firm is expanding its portfolio with plans to develop a Grade-A mall and hotel in Guwahati.

item.title: Loan growth, fall in provisions help SBI profits in Q2
item.description: State Bank of India reported a 14% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 23,038 crore, driven by 18% loan growth, higher net interest income, lower deposit costs and reduced loan loss provisions.

item.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
item.description: Indian equities rallied nearly 2%, with Sensex gaining 1,225 points and Nifty rising 370 points. Falling crude prices, renewed FII buying, resilient earnings and expectations of LTCG tax changes boosted sentiment, adding nearly Rs 4 lakh crore to market capitalisation.

item.title: MCX Q2 Results: Profit rockets 130% YoY to Rs 455 crore, revenue jumps 114%
item.description: Multi Commodity Exchange of India reported a 130% year-on-year jump in Q2FY26 consolidated net profit to Rs 454.57 crore, while revenue surged 114%. EBITDA rose 151%, margins expanded and shares touched a fresh 52-week high.

item.title: Motilal Oswal Financial Services announces leadership rejig; appoints new heads across businesses
item.description: Motilal Oswal Financial Services announced major leadership changes across alternatives, retail broking and private wealth businesses. The reshuffle coincides with strong Q2 performance, with operating PAT rising 29% year-on-year to Rs 718 crore.

item.title: Bata India Q2 Results: Profit rises 30% at Rs 18 crore, revenue rises to Rs 862 crore
item.description: Bata India Ltd achieved a 30.4% increase in net profit for the September quarter of FY27. Revenue from operations also rose by 7.54% to Rs 861.78 crore compared to the previous year. The company noted significant growth in profit after tax, driven by higher average selling prices. Bata India aims to maintain this growth momentum despite rising input costs and wage revisions. Shares of Bata India Ltd increased by 1.

item.title: Happiest Minds Q2 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 62 crore; revenue up 12% to Rs 645 crore
item.description: Happiest Minds Technologies has seen a 15.12% rise in consolidated net profit for the September quarter FY27. Revenue from operations also increased by 12.5% compared to the previous year. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 3.05 per equity share for the 2026-27 fiscal year. An exceptional charge was included in the quarter's results due to a proposed merger with ITC Infotech.

item.title: Emcure Pharma Q2 Results: Profit jumps 29% to Rs 325 crore
item.description: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd has posted a remarkable consolidated net profit of Rs 325.06 crore for the September quarter, reflecting substantial growth. Revenue surged from Rs 2,269.82 crore to Rs 2,820.47 crore during this period, with international operations increasing by 34 per cent. Additionally, domestic revenue witnessed an 11.1 per cent rise, as company leaders expressed confidence in sustaining this positive trend through the latter half of FY27.

item.title: Nexus Select Trust Q2 net operating income rises 8 pc to Rs 504 cr
item.description: Nexus Select Trust has announced an 8% increase in its net operating income for the second quarter. The company reported a distribution of Rs 359 crore, reflecting growth in distribution per unit. Nexus Select Trust has cumulatively distributed over Rs 4,400 crore to its unitholders since its listing. The company marks its strategic entry into Northeast India with plans for a mall and hotel in Guwahati.

item.title: V-Mart Retail Q2 loss widens to Rs 16 crore
item.description: V-Mart Retail reported a significant net loss of Rs 16.34 crore for the September quarter of FY27, a rise from Rs 8.87 crore reported in the same quarter of FY26. Revenue from operations saw an upward trend, increasing by 18 percent year-on-year to Rs 952.99 crore. However, total expenses surged by 22 percent, totaling Rs 976.37 crore. For the first half of FY27, total income reached Rs 2,047.

item.title: Minda Corp Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 68% to Rs 143 crore on strong revenue growth
item.description: Minda Corporation Ltd has reported a significant 68.2% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for Q2. Revenue from operations also increased by 42.6% year-on-year, reaching Rs 2,189 crore. The company's Chairman highlighted continued progress in their growth strategy across key vehicle segments. Electric vehicle-related products contributed around 35% of new order wins during this quarter. Minda plans to enhance its product offerings and invest in R&D and manufacturing capabilities.

item.title: NSE Q2 Results: Profit jumps 23% to Rs 2,578 crore, revenue rises 9%
item.description: NSE Q2 Results: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) reported a 23% year-on-year (YoY) increase in its consolidated profit after tax (PAT) to Rs 2,578 crore in the second quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 2,098 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year (Q2FY26).

item.title: Indian Hotels Company among 6 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 16% in a month
item.description: Six BSE 200 stocks, including Bosch, Coforge, Divi's Laboratories, Eternal, Indian Hotels and Zydus Lifesciences, touched fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex rallied 1,225 points, reflecting renewed market momentum and buying interest.

item.title: Market wrap: BSE, Nestle India, Power Grid, SBI top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
item.description: Indian markets extended gains as the Sensex surged 1,225 points and Nifty climbed 370 points. Falling crude prices, softer US Treasury yields and FII buying boosted sentiment, with FMCG and realty stocks leading the broad-based rally.

item.title: FPIs pour Rs 21,715 crore into Indian stocks in 10 days; is record sell-off finally reversing?
item.description: Foreign portfolio investors infused $2.29 billion into Indian equities over 10 days, signalling improving sentiment. Strong corporate earnings, attractive valuations and potential LTCG tax relief could revive foreign inflows, while crude oil prices remain a key risk.

item.title: R&D-focused stocks deliver over 23% annualised returns in five years, outperform NSE 500: Monarch AIF
item.description: Indian companies increasing R&D spending outperformed the NSE 500 TRI over five years, delivering 23.5% average annualised returns. Businesses combining strong research growth with higher R&D intensity achieved 32.5%, highlighting innovation's growing importance for investors.

item.title: Emcure Pharma shares jump 7% after Q2 profit rises 29% YoY to Rs 325 crore
item.description: Emcure Pharmaceuticals shares rose up to 7.3% after the company reported a 29.3% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 325.1 crore. Revenue grew 24.3%, while EBITDA rose 30.9%, supported by strong international business growth.

item.title: Bonus issue alert! Choice International to reward shareholders with 1:1 bonus shares. Check details
item.description: Choice International has approved a 1:1 bonus issue, its first such corporate action in two years. Under the proposal, shareholders will receive one bonus share for every share held on the record date, which will be announced later. The move will double the number of outstanding shares without changing the company’s market capitalisation, while potentially improving stock liquidity and affordability.

item.title: MFs cut stakes in 8 smallcap stocks after two quarters of buying; shares tumble up to 30% in 3 months
item.description: Mutual funds reduced their holdings in 79 BSE small-cap stocks during the September 2026 quarter, reversing two quarters of accumulation. Several affected stocks fell sharply, with major laggards declining between 24% and 32% over three months.

item.title: BLS E-Services Q2 Results: Net profit rises 12% YoY pc to Rs 20.5 cr
item.description: BLS E-Services reported a 12.4 percent year-on-year increase in profit after tax for Q2 FY27. The total income for the quarter reached Rs 428.1 crore, up 55.1 percent year-on-year. Additionally, the company's operating EBITDA rose to Rs 28.8 crore, marking a 43.8 percent increase from the previous year. The Business Correspondent segment also achieved a Gross Transaction Value of over Rs 41,400 crore.

item.title: SBI Q2 Results: Standalone profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 23,038 crore, NII jumps 15%
item.description: SBI Q2 Results: Net interest income in the reporting period increased 15% YoY to Rs 49,143 crore.

item.title: NSE International Exchange begins 23.5-hour trading, extends market access across global time zones
item.description: NSE International Exchange has introduced a 23.5-hour trading schedule, providing near-continuous market access across Asian, European and American time zones. The extended window aims to help global investors respond to international developments while strengthening GIFT City’s position as a global financial hub.

item.title: GRSE shares jump 9% after signing Rs 32,000 crore Indian Navy contract for five next-generation corvettes
item.description: GRSE shares surged nearly 9% after securing a Rs 32,000-crore Indian Navy contract to build five Next Generation Corvettes. The nine-year project will strengthen indigenous defence manufacturing, enhance maritime capabilities and reinforce GRSE's warship-building position, adding significantly to its order book and long-term business prospects.

item.title: 4 reasons why Reliance Industries shares can rally after Monday magic sparked historic 12% surge
item.description: Reliance Industries shares surged, their biggest single-day gain since April 2020, adding nearly Rs 2 lakh crore to the company's market capitalisation after strong Q2 results. Despite remaining down over 17% in 2026, analysts see further upside potential, citing positive fundamental and technical cues.

item.title: Bajaj Finserv Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 23% YoY to Rs 2,758 crore, shares rise 2%
item.description: Bajaj Finserv Q2 Results: The firm’s revenue from operations, meanwhile, increased around 17% YoY to Rs 43,416 crore during the second quarter of FY27, from Rs 37,215 crore reported in the year-ago period.

item.title: Angel One, CDSL, BSE, other capital market stocks jump up to 8%. 3 reasons behind the rally
item.description: Capital market stocks rallied up to 8% as hopes of LTCG tax relief, renewed FII buying and a broader market recovery lifted investor sentiment. The Nifty Capital Markets index climbed over 3% to a seven-week high.

item.title: Uncertainty is certain: India is resilient and will emerge stronger
item.description: Despite global uncertainty, India remains well placed to weather economic and market disruptions, supported by resilient growth, deeper domestic capital markets and rising private investment. Stronger institutions, infrastructure spending and emerging industries could further reinforce the country’s long-term prospects.

item.title: KRBL shares rally 9% after Q2 net profit jumps 51% YoY
item.description: KRBL shares jumped nearly 9% after the company reported a 51% rise in second-quarter profit, supported by strong domestic sales and improved operating performance. Revenue increased 14%, while EBITDA climbed sharply, reinforcing positive momentum in the stock.

item.title: Only 3.2% of working Indians trade stocks. Why Morgan Stanley likes NSE
item.description: Morgan Stanley has initiated coverage of NSE with an overweight rating and a price target of Rs 2,315, citing its dominant market share, strong liquidity and India’s underpenetrated capital markets. The brokerage expects revenue and normalised profit to grow at 15% annually between FY27 and FY29. It sees long-term growth opportunities but flags regulatory changes and market-share losses as key risks.

item.title: Record-breaking FII selling may have peaked, says Nomura. Why the Nifty target could rise
item.description: FIIs may be nearing the end of their record selling spree in Indian equities as outflows ease, earnings beat expectations and valuations fall below post-pandemic averages, according to Nomura. Foreign investors sold around $8.8 billion since September 15, although the pace has moderated. Meanwhile, companies in Nomura’s BSE 200+ universe reported 34% year-on-year profit growth, beating consensus estimates by 18%.

item.title: US midterm elections today: Can Trump’s pain be Dalal Street’s gain? Analysts estimate impact in 3 possible scenarios
item.description: The United States will hold crucial midterm elections that could significantly alter the balance of power in Congress. Analysts are focusing on potential scenarios that could emerge based on whether the Democrats or Republicans hold the majority. These outcomes may impact critical issues such as tariffs, immigration, foreign relations, and even oil prices.

item.title: Trident shares rally 13% after Q2 net profit jumps 93% to Rs 175 crore; firm plans Rs 4,650 crore capex
item.description: Trident shares rallied 13% after the company reported a 93.1% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 175.50 crore. Improved EBITDA and margins supported earnings growth, while the company announced a Rs 4,650-crore capacity expansion and modernisation programme.

item.title: Diwali stocks by Motilal Oswal: Eternal, Adani Ports among 10 stocks with upside of up to 40%. See full list
item.description: Motilal Oswal has identified ten stocks poised for remarkable growth in the market landscape. Anticipated leaders like Kotak Mahindra Bank and Titan are forecasted to achieve significant earnings boosts. Projections for FY27 suggest a revival of double-digit growth across various sectors. Notably, Adani Ports and Eternal stand out among the select recommendations, urging investors to consider these stocks for their portfolios.

item.title: Smallcap stocks to buy this Diwali! 5 stocks with upside potential of up to 37%. Do you own any?
item.description: As Diwali approaches, Mirae Asset Sharekhan highlights five promising smallcap stocks with potential for significant growth. DEE Development targets Rs 750, suggesting a possible 37% increase. Similarly, Karnataka Bank is set at Rs 415, indicating a 33% rise. Additionally, Lumax Auto Technologies and VA Tech Wabag offer targets of Rs 2,490 and Rs 2,400 respectively, making them appealing options for investors eyeing gains based on robust fundamentals.

item.title: LTCG abolition may cost just Rs 40,000–50,000 crore, SBI estimates show
item.description: SBI Research estimates that abolishing long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax would cost the government just Rs 40,000–50,000 crore in FY27, far below the Rs 1.3 lakh crore collected in FY25. Weaker stock market returns and sustained foreign investor outflows have significantly reduced expected collections, suggesting the move may not derail the government's fiscal consolidation plans.

item.title: ideaForge shares jump 7% as firm swings to profit in Q2, revenue soars 124% YoY
item.description: ideaForge shares surged over 7% after the company reported a turnaround to a Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 6.46 crore, while revenue jumped 124% year-on-year to Rs 91.29 crore. Improved operating performance and new defence technology milestones boosted investor interest.

item.title: IndiGo, Indian Oil and other crude-sensitive stocks rally up to 4% as oil dips below $105/bbl. Where are prices headed?
item.description: Crude-sensitive stocks such as IndiGo, BPCL, HPCL and Indian Oil rallied up to 4% as oil prices declined for a second consecutive session amid US-Iran peace talks. Upstream stocks ONGC and Oil India, however, fell up to 2%. Lower crude prices typically benefit downstream companies by easing input costs and supporting refining and marketing margins.

item.title: Hunting for Diwali winners? 8 brokerages name 58 stocks with big upside potential; Eternal, L&T among top picks
item.description: Eight brokerages have shortlisted 58 stocks for their Diwali 2026 portfolios across sectors such as banking, IT, defence, automobiles and hospitality. Eternal, L&T and Indian Hotels are the most popular picks, featuring in four brokerage portfolios each, while Kotak Mahindra Bank appears in three. ICICI Bank, Tech Mahindra, Tata Steel and Adani Ports are among the other recurring recommendations.

item.title: Why did market rally today? Sensex jumps 1,225 pts, Nifty closes above 23,800. 6 key factors behind today's surge
item.description: The Indian stock market witnessed a notable uptick on Tuesday, with Sensex and Nifty showing substantial growth. This surge was primarily driven by declining oil prices and favorable sentiments around the long-term capital gains tax. Enthusiasm among investors surged, particularly following significant net buying from foreign institutional investors. Though sectors such as Nifty Auto and Financial Services rallied, Nifty Pharma lagged behind.

item.title: L&T Share Price Highlights: L&T Stock Price History
$64 billion out, $5 billion in? Why LTCG tax cut may not be enough to bring FIIs back
item.description: A reassessment of long-term capital gains tax is underway as foreign investors continue their significant selloff from Indian equities. Analysts at JM Financial project that tax relief may yield only $3–5 billion in fresh inflows. This minimal increase may not be sufficient to reverse the current trend of investor exodus amidst concerns over oil prices. India’s tax regime differentiates between dollar and rupee gains, impacting foreign investor returns significantly.

item.title: SBI Share Price Highlights: SBI Stock Price History
Reliance Industries among 8 stocks showing RSI Trending Up
item.description: An uptrend signal occurs when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below.

item.title: ITC shares rise 2% after Q2 results. What are Jefferies, Nuvama and others saying?
item.description: ITC shares gained 2% despite an 18.5% year-on-year decline in Q2 net profit, as higher taxes and falling cigarette earnings weighed on profitability. However, its FMCG business delivered strong growth. Jefferies, Nuvama, Emkay and DAM Capital remain positive on the stock, with target prices ranging from Rs 300 to Rs 355.

item.title: Nifty's Diwali-to-Diwali slide: Will year-end gains light up Dalal Street?
item.description: The Nifty index has faced notable drops over the last year, heavily impacted by foreign investor outflows and surging crude oil prices. Experts indicate a chance for a year-end comeback, dependent on better corporate earnings and domestic investments. Nevertheless, ongoing volatility and geopolitical strains might limit market advancements in the next few months. The September-quarter earnings season hints at improvement, potentially raising investor confidence.

item.title: Marico shares jump 6% as strong Q2 puts growth story in overdrive, sparks bullish calls
item.description: Marico reported a 31% YoY rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 550 crore, while revenue grew 12% to Rs 3,897 crore. Improved margins and strong volume growth prompted brokerages Jefferies, Systematix and Dolat Capital to maintain or upgrade Buy ratings and raise target prices, signalling optimism about growth prospects.

item.title: Karur Vysya Bank among 4 F&O stocks with sharp rise in futures open interest
item.description: A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security.
